product.normalization: generic JSON signal extraction, no Git-specific operators
product.algorithm: 2x2 pair each cell one contemporaneous native tools/list + one successful tools/call; bind call response to original effect witness by raw SHA and typed original-record JSON pointers; determine state-change boolean independently of kind; compare locked effect pattern and control, result hash equivalence as separate observational property

dev.origin: B19 official modelcontextprotocol PyPI publisher signed wheel
dev.exact_input: locked B19 4 original raw stdio traces and marker external witness

independent.runtime: Python 3.11 mcp==2.3.0, original PyPI distribution CLI python -I -m filesystem_mcp, temporary local allowed directory only
independent.cohort_selection: source-informed selection of unrelated real publisher and new tool semantics, not blind defect discovery

design.labels: before / after are INDEPENDENT REPEATS OF THE SAME 1.0.2 DISTRIBUTION, not a historical bug-fix pair
design.expected_outcome: exact 2x2 content-change truth table with normal tool responses; no hidden security defect claim; MCP result comparison not required

risk_controls: All paths relative to a newly created ephemeral root; server allowed directory is fixture only
No access to user files, secrets, accounts, private servers or network operations by the tool
Install original version separately; compare module to upstream Git blob before first tool call
No Git source in the generic verifier and no source or target changes
Missing independent observer, run mismatch, changed actual trace, tool errors are not a passing effect verdict
Historical B19 positive cannot be counted as independent defect discovery
Execution status and effect obligations separate: not all changed effects are unauthorized
No hardcoded Git key or file path in frozen product core
No regression to product in response to held-out result; audit harness separately
boundary: One new external source with normal file write invariants tests transfer of evidence architecture and sensor types. It does not estimate unknown bug detection recall or establish a new upstream security defect.
